brief:
Israeli occupation forces launched coordinated raids across multiple towns and cities throughout the West Bank early Saturday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations involved military deployments and incursions into residential neighborhoods, with particular focus on areas surrounding the Arab American University in Jenin Governorate.

The synchronized raids unfolded across several governorates during the pre-dawn hours as part of what appeared to be a broader security operation. Military forces moved through populated areas, conducting the sweeps in tandem with broader deployments across the occupied territory.
